Al Scripture.''] {{outside L|The great profit of reading the Scriptures.}}Be{{ls}}ides the Apo{{ls}}tles teaching and tradition, the reading of holy Scriptures is a great defen{{ls}}e and helpe of the faithful, aud {{ls}}pecially of a Bi{{ls}}hop, not onely to auoid and condemne al here{{ls}}ies, but to the guiding of a man in al iu{{ls}}tice, good life and vvorkes. For he affirmeth euery Scripture to haue the fore{{ls}}aid vtilities. and they might {{ls}}ee in the very next line before, that he requireth his con{{ls}}tant per{{ls}}euerance in the doctrine vvhich he had taught him ouer and aboue that he had learned out of the Scriptures of the old Te{{ls}}tament, vvhich he had read from his infancie, but could not thereby learne al the my{{ls}}teries of Chri{{ls}}tian religion therein.
